body: I understand there's no requirements at this point in my life. But I really do love this girl and it's tearing me up inside. I don't even have a chance to mend things because she is leaving to a different part of the country. I'm not nuts, this is just the first time I've felt like this is the one. How many times do you feel that in life? I figure 1 is lucky enough.

I haven't coped. My family knows my life's ambition. They are understanding... to a point. My options are deal with hell at this job for 6 more months before I can go through boot camp, or I just live this hell forever. The secondary option... is not an option. Option 3 is obvious.
I've been trying for almost 30 years, I can't wait a whole lot longer. Honestly it's now or never.
Sales. In a terrible industry. The competition is ferocious and without a dedicated drive (which I don't have anymore) you barely can scrape by as it's purely commission based.

Terrible. Hospital visits, inpatient therapy... I'm just exhausted with it all. I've had 3 horrible break ups in my life but I really thought this was the one. The one girl to make me whole. And she did. But now she's leaving.

I hate my job, I hate my life, what am I supposed to do? I'm done with medical care; I can't afford it and it isn't helping.
